title: KVLCC2 MARIN and HSVA free-running model tests
relatedPaper: Alexandersson et al., System identification of Vessel Manoeuvring Models, Ocean Engineering 266 (2022) 112905

license.reason: Source repository has no LICENSE; public GitHub visibility is not a redistribution grant and SIMMAN participant terms are unknown.

marin.model: KVLCC2 MARIN L7, scale 45.7, single screw

expectedEffectiveSampleIntervalS.definition: (last printed time-first printed time)/(row_count-1); printed scientific notation becomes quantized and may repeat at long durations

columnMapping.name: time_s_full_scale_equivalent
columnMapping.evidence: monotonic/quantized time; cadence equals model sampling scaled by sqrt(45.7)

columnMapping.name: global_x_m_full_scale_equivalent
columnMapping.evidence: initial derivative agrees with full-scale surge speed; turning advance is about 3.1-3.3 full-scale Lpp

columnMapping.name: global_y_m_full_scale_equivalent
columnMapping.evidence: turning/zig-zag track, body-to-global kinematics, and tactical diameter about 3.1-3.4 full-scale Lpp

columnMapping.name: roll_deg
columnMapping.evidence: derivative correlates with column 8 on turning and zig-zag

columnMapping.name: heading_unwrapped_deg
columnMapping.evidence: turn accumulation/zig-zag oscillation; derivative correlates with column 9

columnMapping.name: surge_velocity_mps_full_scale_equivalent
columnMapping.evidence: about 8 m/s, matching the published 15.5-knot full-scale approach speed and global-position derivative

columnMapping.name: sway_velocity_mps_full_scale_equivalent
columnMapping.evidence: body/global kinematic consistency and sign reversal with maneuvers

columnMapping.name: roll_rate_deg_s
columnMapping.evidence: integrates consistently with column 4 on both maneuver classes

columnMapping.name: yaw_rate_deg_s
columnMapping.evidence: integrates consistently with unwrapped heading on both maneuver classes

columnMapping.name: rudder_angle_deg
columnMapping.evidence: 35-degree step in turning runs and alternating 10/20-degree zig-zag commands; MARIN sign is opposite the MMG core input sign, established by negative delta producing positive measured yaw

columnMapping.name: propeller_revolutions_rpm_full_scale_equivalent
columnMapping.evidence: 91.665 rpm nominal with ±0.4 rpm sample variation, zero speed correlation, and Froude consistency with the HMRI self-propulsion point within 3.5%; supplied clarification dated 2026-08-03

trajectoryScaling.evidence: 8 m/s approach speed, roughly 1000 m advance, and Froude-scaled time are mutually consistent; model-scale interpretation is physically impossible

rudderAdapter.rateHandling: measured actual angle replayed directly; no second rate limiter
rudderAdapter.evidence: Across all runs rudder/yaw-rate correlation is negative, while the MMG core convention gives positive yaw moment for positive rudder.

hsva.compatibilityReason: Upstream pins Kedro 0.17.6/Python 3.7; the platform runs the archived pipeline's two pure transform nodes exactly under the pinned workspace Python.

claimLimit: Measured single-screw KVLCC2 model-scale trajectories support maneuvering-model structure at the MARIN model configuration; they do not validate Vehicle B USV-scale coefficients.
